## Checklist

- [ ] The pull request contains one logical change.
- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behavior, or the change does not affect runtime behavior.
- [ ] `src/` remains browser- and Node-safe (no `fs`, `path`, `Buffer`, or DOM APIs).
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies were added, or they were discussed first.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and the package version are unchanged.
- [ ] No generated files (`lib/`, `node_modules/`, `test/_output/`) are committed.
- [ ] I agree to follow this project's [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/yegor-pelykh/image-in-browser/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
